1.text: Iyi ndirimbo ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

2.text: Mana, umutima wanjye urakomeye,Ndaririmba, ni koko ndaririmbisha ishimwe ubwiza bwanjye.

3.text: Nebelu n'inanga nimukanguke,Nanjye ubwanjye nzakanguka mbere y'umuseke.

4.text: Uwiteka, nzagushimira mu moko,Nzakuririmbira ishimwe mu mahanga.

5.text: Kuko imbabazi zawe ari ndende zisumba ijuru,Umurava wawe ugera mu bicu.

6.text: Mana, wishyire hejuru y'ijuru,Icyubahiro cyawe kibe hejuru y'isi yose.

7.text: Ukirishe ukuboko kwawe kw'iburyo unsubize,Kugira ngo abo ukunda bakizwe.

8.text: Imana yarahiye kwera kwayo iti“Nzishima,Nzagabanya Shekemu,Kandi nzagabanisha urugero igikombe cy'i Sukoti.

9.text: Galeyadi ni ahanjye,Umuryango wa Manase ni uwanjye,Uwa Efurayimu ni wo ukingira umutwe wanjye,Uwa Yuda ni wo nkoni yanjye y'ubwami.

10.text: Abamowabu ni bo gikarabiro cyanjye,Abedomu nzabakubita inkweto mu mutwe,Abafilisitiya nzabishima hejuru mvuza impundu.”

11.text: Ni nde uzanyinjiza mu mudugudu ufite igihome gikomeye?Ni nde uzangeza muri Edomu?

12.text: Si wowe Mana wadutaye, uzangezayo?Si wowe Mana utajyanaga n'ingabo zacu, uzangezayo?

13.text: Udutabare umubisha,Kuko gutabara kw'abantu kutagira umumaro.

14.text: Imana izadukoresha iby'ubutwari,Kuko ari yo izaribata ababisha bacu.
